# ME-GU - Cooperation Training Program between Hanoi University of Science and Technology, Vietnam and Griffith University, Australia

**Name of program:** Mechanical Machine Engineering (International cooperation academic programme)

**Education level:** Engineer

**Major:** Mechanical Engineering

**Program codes:** 7520130 (Engineering)

**Duration:** 5 years

**Credits in total:** 159 credits

content:
## A. Program Goals

Upon successful completion of the international cooperation training program in Mechanical Engineering, students will achieve:

1. Basic knowledge and skills in mathematics and applied sciences in the fields of mechanics, electricity-electronics, control, and information technology to meet the acquisition of specialized knowledge; Having specialized knowledge to operate, maintain, calculate and design mechanical systems; solve mechanical technical issues.
2. Personal and professional skills suitable to an interdisciplinary working environment, international integration and adapting to the industrial revolution 4.0; can start a business.
3. Effective communication and teamwork skills in a professional environment and in the community.
4. The ability to formulate ideas, design, implement and operate the system in the context of business and society.

content:
## B. Program Learning Outcomes

On successful completion of the programme, students will have the following knowledge and ability:

**1. Broad professional knowledge** to adapt well to jobs related to the mechanical engineering field; focusing on the ability to apply basic knowledge and core knowledge of the field in combination with the ability to use modern tools to operate mechanical engineering systems/processes/products:

- 1.1 The ability to apply knowledge of mathematics and basic science to design and calculate mechanical systems / processes / products.
- 1.2 The ability to apply the background knowledge of the field to perform an analysis on mechanical systems / processes / products.
- 1.3 The ability to apply core knowledge of the field, combined with the capability to exploit and use modern methods and tools to participate in the design and evaluation of mechanical engineering systems / processes / products.
- 1.4 The ability to apply core knowledge of the field to explore, design, develop, and lead the operation of mechanical production systems/processes.

**2. Professional skills and personal qualities** needed to succeed in the career:

- 2.1 Skills in detecting, analyzing and solving problems in mechanical engineering field.
- 2.2 Skills in systematic and critical thinking.
- 2.3 Dynamism, seriousness, and perseverance.
- 2.4 The ability to experiment, explore knowledge, and conduct research and development.
- 2.5 Ethics and professional responsibilities.
- 2.6 An understanding of contemporary issues and lifelong learning.

**3. Social skills** needed to work effectively in multidisciplinary teams and in an international environment:

- 3.1 Skills in collaboration, organization, and teamwork.
- 3.2 Communication skills through writing, presentation, discussion, effectively using modern tools and media.
- 3.3 Skills in using English at work according to the regulations of the university.

**4. The ability to participate in the design / construction / development** of mechanical systems / processes / products / technical solutions in fields of mechanical engineering in current social and environmental context:

- 4.1 The awareness of the close relationship and the influence of technology solutions in mechanical engineering to economical, social, and environmental factors in a globalized world.
- 4.2 The ability to identify problems and to form ideas of technical solutions; the ability to participate in project settings related to mechanical engineering.
- 4.3 The ability to design mechanical systems / processes / products / solutions.
- 4.4 Ability to implement / manufacture / exploit mechanical systems / processes / products / technical solutions.

**5. Political qualities, a sense of service to the people, and good health** to meet the requirements of the national construction and defense:

- 5.1 Political theoretical qualifications under the general regulations program of the Ministry of Education and Training.
- 5.2 Physical education certificate and certificate of national defense and security according to the regular for the general Bachelor program from the Ministry of Education and Training.

## D. Transfer Requirements

- A minimum overall band score of 6.5 on IELTS (Academic) with no sub-score of less than 6.0
- OR a minimum score of 575 on TOEFL
- OR an internet-based (iBT) TOEFL score of 79 (no sub-score less than 19)
- OR no score less than 3+ in each skill of the ISLPR (conducted by ISLPR Language Services only)
- OR a minimum overall score of 176 (no score less than 169) on C1 Advanced (formerly Cambridge Certificate in Advanced English) or C2 Proficiency (formerly Cambridge Certificate of Proficiency in English)
- OR an overall score of 58 in the Pearson Test of English (Academic) with no score less than 50.

English test results must be no more than two years old. Applicants should refer to the following University procedure for further information.

**Useful Links:**
- International Scholarships and Finance: https://www.griffith.edu.au/international/scholarships-finance

- Course for Engineering (Bachelor): https://www.griffith.edu.au/study/degrees/bachelor-of-engineering-honours1546?location=intl&level=pgrd&pathway=nsl

## E. Employment Opportunities after Graduation

- Students have the opportunity to find employment immediately after graduation with an average salary of 10 to 20 million VND/month.
- Students who graduate in Australia will be awarded a degree by Griffith University and are allowed to work in Australia for a minimum of 2 years.

*Source: Australian Government Job Outlook*

**Typical job positions include:**

- Design engineers, managers, and operators at domestic and international factories, enterprises, and corporations in the field of mechanical engineering.
- Lecturers, researchers at universities, research institutes, and government agencies.
- Pursue postgraduate studies and research at universities in Vietnam and abroad.
